From breathtaking natural wonders like geysers, waterfalls, an d lava fields to a relaxing soak in the Blue Lagoon , book our Golden Circle Small Group Tour and Blue Lagoon Transfer for a perfect blend of adventure and tranquility. Delve into the history at Thingvellir National Park , witness the force of nature at Geysir geothermal area , and be captivated by Gullfoss , among Iceland’s most magnificent waterfalls. The journey culminates with a soothing dip in the Blue Lagoon. What is included in the Golden Circle & Blue Lagoon tour? This tour combines the most popular sights of the Golden Circle with a transfer to Iceland’s most famous geothermal spa, giving you flexibility to plan your Blue Lagoon visit. Thingvellir National Park (UNESCO World Heritage Site) Geysir Geothermal Area and Strokkur geyser Gullfoss waterfall Blue Lagoon transfer (admission not included) Remember to secure your Blue Lagoon tickets ahead of time, as these are not included in your tour ticket. You should book the 17:00 / 5 PM slot. If you prefer a fully included experience with Blue Lagoon admission, you can also explore our Golden Circle & Blue Lagoon tour with admission . No problem. Read FAQ or contact us on live chat or [email protected] Frequently Asked Questions What are the main stops on the Golden Circle & Blue Lagoon Transfer? The Golden Circle & Blue Lagoon transfer typically includes stops at Kerið Volcanic Crater Lake, the Geysir Geothermal Area, Gullfoss Waterfall, Thingvellir National Park, and transfers to and from the Blue Lagoon, These sites highlight Iceland’s unique geology, natural beauty, and historical significance. Please note that the itinerary may be subject to change due to weather or road conditions, to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience. What should I prepare for my Blue Lagoon visit? Admission to the Blue Lagoon is not included in the tour. It is very important to book your ticket in advance to ensure it fits the schedule. To allow enough time for the Blue Lagoon experience and the transfer back to Reykjavik, you should book the entrance time at 5:00 PM (17:00) . Tickets can be booked directly here: Blue Lagoon Day Visit . The Blue Lagoon is extremely popular, and time slots often sell out quickly, so securing your admission well ahead of your tour date is essential. Do you have a Golden Circle tour that includes the Blue Lagoon admission ticket? Yes, we have a small group Golden Circle tour with Blue Lagoon admission included. The package includes a Blue Lagoon Comfort Entrance ticket with towel, face mask, and a free drink at the in-lagoon bar. Learn more and book here: Golden Circle & Blue Lagoon Small Group Tour . How does the pick-up process work for the Golden Circle & Blue Lagoon transfer tour? Pickup starts at the experience time shown on your ticket and may take up to 30 minutes. Please be ready at your designated pickup location from the start time, as you may be the first stop of the day. Please wait at the pickup location you selected during the booking process for your guide, and make sure we have your correct email and phone number so we can contact you if needed. Feel free to check our Reykjavík pickup locations on the website . Are there additional or alternative stops that can be included on a Golden Circle day tour? Here are several options for you with a Golden Circle tour and an added extra: Golden Circle & Laugaras Lagoon Golden Circle, Friðheimar, and Sky Lagoon Please see all the Golden Circle tours in Iceland .
